difficulty_reason: H2: constant-target reachability is converted into infinite-dimensional dense reachability by constructing a Volterra commutator identity with a finite-dimensional boundary term and recursively lifting polynomial degrees through integrated controls. Identifying and cancelling that boundary term in an arbitrary positive-delay matrix system is the nonroutine step; polynomial density alone does not establish the result. No commensurability, two-state or scalar-input restriction is added.
